methodology.input: Historical public basic start cards only: entries, rider ranks/scores/styles, lineup and race identifiers; no current form, s_counts, EX or post-race signals
methodology.model_time: Present repository engine revision replayed on old cards; NOT stored before-race forecasts
methodology.odds: 100JPY per distinct trifecta ticket; outcome payout records used only for settlement
methodology.additional_loser_rounds: 特選/特秀/特優/特別優秀/敗者/順位決定
methodology.fairness: complete_case contains races where every compared engine returned a valid ticket set, with no outcome-based filtering
methodology.risks: Public archive feed is not independently official-verified; rules and model revisions were built with historical information, so in-sample bias persists; models with different ticket counts have different spend
